include some hormones such as estrogen or testosterone. Th ese
promoters require an activation of the carcinogen as well as a
failure of natural immunity and cellular repair mechanisms. 
Conditions must be conducive for the neoplasm (tumor) to 
continue to grow. Tumor growth rate is dependent on charac-
teristics of the host such as age, sex, overall health, nutritional 
status, and immune function.
